text_block_list.text:
Contrary to our anxieties, Gold Ship 
delivered a spectacular run.

Expectations for her future races are 
rising even higher...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All done, all done. Phew~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing is your greatest weapon, after 
all. Drop your shoulders and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, now that you've finally relaxed, 
let's shift into an easygoing life for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"With my talent, even a wasteland can 
become a giant carrot plantation."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go show the world just how 
wonderful the organic lifestyle is.

I try calling out to her, but Gold Ship 
shows no sign of turning around.
Just as I thought to chase after them—
—I am very disappointed, Golshi-san.

"So you are truly stepping away from the 
battle now, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Who's that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, Flash. Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have been tasked by a "certain 
someone" to deliver a message to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have brought along some information 
today as well that might prove useful to 
you, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you intend to step away from racing, 
then I suppose it is no longer necessary.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Information?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is a hint pointing towards the 
"Eden" you seek.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wha... What!? Did you say... Eden!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "—By the way, what was Eden again?"
choice_data_list:
Like a utopia for Umamusume... or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's the one!! That sounds pretty 
fun!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Flash, I take back what I just said! So 
please tell me, give me a clue to Eden!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So you've reconsidered. However, I am also 
entrusted with vital information. I cannot 
simply give it away that easily.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, would you do battle with me? On the 
stage of the upcoming Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen? You saying you'll tell me 
if we fight there?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail. I promise you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fine by me! This'll be fun! Let's 
settle it at the Arima Kinen!

I wondered who the "certain person" who 
entrusted Eishin Flash with the 
information could be, but—

All in all, it's great to see Gold Ship's 
motivation turning towards the races!
